  ticket.display_mode: Controls how ticket IDs are displayed in CLI output and skill prompts.
    Values: canonical (default) | alias | short
    canonical: full 16-hex format xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx
    alias: human-readable adj-noun-noun alias (requires CREATE event data.alias; falls back to canonical for pre-migration tickets)
    short: shortest unambiguous prefix >= 4 chars (falls back to canonical if ambiguous)

Place in the ticket.* config key section, alphabetically after ticket.display (if present) or in a new ticket subsection.
